primary_source_title: Surface and Subsurface Behavior of a Natural Gas Storage Site over Time: The Case of the Cornegliano Gas Field
notes: The peer-reviewed source reports an initial/static reservoir pressure of 161 bar at ~1330 m and an end-of-production reservoir pressure of 50 bar. It also describes the low-inventory bottom-hole operating threshold as approximately 40–50 bar. Directly pairing 50 bar pre-conversion pressure with a 45 bar minimum operating pressure violates the cost model's required ordering P_preconversion < P_min. For this sweep we therefore use 45 bar as the model pre-conversion pressure and 50 bar as the minimum operating pressure. Both lie inside the reported 40–50 bar low-pressure band, but this 45/50 ordering is a modelling adjustment, not a directly observed paired state. Pmax=161 bar remains the reported static/original reservoir pressure.

primary_source_title: CAMPO DI SABBIONCELLO – STUDIO DI GIACIMENTO, Relazione 18/96 (AGIP, May 1996)
notes: Compiled from multiple sources. The 1996 AGIP reservoir study reports initial static bottom-hole pressure of 146.1 kg/cm²(a) at datum 1163 m, primary production ending in 1981, and static pressure of 60.7 kg/cm²(a) (~59.5 bar(a)) near the end of primary production. Storage began in July 1985, by which time reservoir pressure had recovered to 70 kg/cm²(a) (~68.65 bar(a)); this storage-start pressure is used as model_abandonment_pressure_bar because it best represents the pressure present when conversion to storage began. SciGRID independently reports raw depth=1100 m, Pmin=77.4 bar and Pmax=142.2 bar. The raw SciGRID Pmax is also close to the AGIP original pressure (~143.3 bar after unit conversion), providing a useful cross-check. The peer-reviewed Italian UHS survey is included as a secondary DOI-backed site/context source.

primary_source_title: IMPIANTI CONCESSIONE SETTALA STOCCAGGIO – Stabilimento di SETTALA (MI)
notes: Compiled from official permit documentation plus SciGRID. The main SAN P/E reservoir entered storage service in 1986 at the end of primary production. The official Stogit document reports that static average pressure had declined from 140.4 kg/cm²(a) to 103.6 kg/cm²(a) at a datum of 1158 m; the latter converts to ~101.60 bar(a) and is used as model_abandonment_pressure_bar. observed_or_modelled: Documented design archetype, cross-checked against later operational sources
primary_source_title: World Bank Staff Appraisal Report: Hungary Energy Development and Conservation Project (Zsana-North UGS component)
notes: A deliberate design-case rather than a reconstruction of one later operating year. The 1989 World Bank appraisal evaluated six Zsana-North conversion alternatives; the least-cost Alternative 6 assumed further depletion to 60 bar before conversion and a 65–140 bar operating range. These three values are used because they form one internally coherent documented conversion design. Later Hungarian historical material states that production was actually stopped in 1990 at ~98 bar to preserve cushion gas, and SciGRID reports raw depth=1850 m with a later 96–128 bar operating range. Combining the realized ~98 bar conversion state with the later 96 bar minimum would violate the model ordering P_preconversion < P_min and would mix different operational eras. Therefore this row explicitly represents the World Bank design archetype, not the exact realized conversion state. Depth is anchored to the raw SciGRID value and is consistent with operator documentation (~1880–1920 m).

depth_basis: Peer-reviewed field-demonstrator depth: 1100 m TVD below surface (528 m TVD below mean sea level)
pressure_basis: Peer-reviewed static reservoir range 22–107 bar(a), with minimum operating pressure deliberately set to the study's 55 bar reference pipeline/suction pressure for model comparability
stored_gas_or_scenario: Pure H2 field demonstrator in depleted natural-gas reservoir
observed_or_modelled: Observed field demonstrator + explicit Pmin model adjustment
primary_source_title: Pioneering underground hydrogen storage: Insights from a first-of-its-kind field demonstrator in a depleted gas reservoir
notes: The 2026 peer-reviewed field paper reports depth=1100 m below surface and a static reservoir pressure range of 22–107 bar(a). It also reports staged cushion-gas preparation: ~1 million Nm³ natural gas held the reservoir at ~37 bar(a), and subsequent H2 cushion injection raised it to ~46 bar(a); the tubing-head flowing envelope during H2 operation was about 30–70 bar(g). The unadjusted low-pressure site values are below the common 55 bar pipeline/compressor-suction reference used in the cost model. To retain this highly relevant pure-H2 DGF demonstrator in a comparable cost sweep, Pmin is therefore set deliberately to 55 bar. P_preconversion=22 bar and Pmax=107 bar remain the peer-reviewed reservoir values. This row must be interpreted as a partially model-adjusted site case, not the exact demonstrated operating envelope.
